name: Paygram
pitch: Launch a token routed to a Telegram, X, GitHub, or Fomo @username.
card: Launch a token routed to a Telegram, X, GitHub, or Fomo @username.
roleTodoDetail: usepaygram.com does not name a personal title.
paragraphs: Paygram’s site says you launch a token, stock, or basket paired to any handle on Telegram, X, GitHub, or Fomo. You pick a @username; Paygram mints the token, routes creator fees in SOL, and pays 80% to that handle’s social-linked wallet. Unclaimed fees stay in the vault.

The fees page says Paygram adds no trade fee on pump.fun launches. Of the creator fee, 80% goes to the handle and/or holders and 20% buys and burns $PAYGRAM. Creating a coin has no Paygram fee; network fees still apply, and a dev buy is optional.
features: Launch a token, stock, or basket paired to a Telegram, X, GitHub, or Fomo handle
Creator fees paid in SOL to a social-linked wallet
80% of the creator fee to the handle and/or holders; 20% buys and burns $PAYGRAM
Unclaimed fees stay in the vault
